usageNotes: Use this to update an existing node's configuration within an SDN fabric — for example, changing its IP address, WireGuard endpoint, allowed CIDRs, or role. Requires both SDN.Allocate on the fabric path and Sys.Modify on the target node; both privileges must be satisfied simultaneously. The 'protocol' field is required on every update call and must match the fabric's protocol type — sending a mismatched protocol will be rejected.

examples.summary: Update a WireGuard fabric node's allowed IPs and endpoint

tips: Pass the 'digest' from the current node config to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.
The 'delete' and 'interfaces' arrays are marked required in the spec — even when making no changes to those fields, pass empty arrays rather than omitting them.
For external WireGuard nodes, 'public_key' and 'endpoint' are typically both needed; internal nodes rely on auto-exchanged keys from the cluster.
Changes to SDN fabric nodes take effect only after running the SDN apply step (PUT /cluster/sdn/fabrics/{fabric_id}/apply or equivalent reload).
